main_text.p: πλέον περαίτερον τυτον. μάλα μᾶλλον μά-λισα. ἀεὶ ἀεί̈τερον. & à uerbo φέρων fit φέρ-τερος, τατος, uel φέρεις.

page.notes: The Greek of the opening lines and some accents in the table are hard to read at this scan resolution and may contain errors. The table cells are separated by " | " in column order. The left-margin marks "υς" and "ας" and the reference symbols before some lines are printed in the table lines. The faint mirrored text in the right margin is show-through and is left out.
